name: Brighton Resort
locality: Brighton, UT (top of Big Cottonwood Canyon, SR-190)

source.note: Piste reference data (not web-verified in this build) — confirm at source. Approximate base-lodge position at the top of SR-190

Search summary (OnTheSnow overview, Brighton mountain stats): base 8,755 ft, top 10,500 ft, vertical drop 1,875 ft (Brighton's own stats also give 1,875 ft). Converted to metres. features.beginnerArea: Explorer lift area near the base (confirm)

source.note: Piste reference data (not web-verified in this build) — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Night skiing on part of the mountain is a long-standing Brighton feature; 2026-27 nights and hours are unconfirmed Search summary (2026-09-30; OnTheSnow/Visit Utah results): night skiing covers 250+ acres with 32 lighted runs, Monday to Saturday nights.

character: A mid-sized ski area at the top of Big Cottonwood Canyon, next to Solitude, with a strong local and snowboard following, terrain parks and lift-served night skiing on part of the mountain.
learning: Reference note: beginner terrain sits near the base, served by the Explorer lift, and the resort runs a ski and snowboard school. Confirm current learning lifts, carpets and lesson products.

source.note: Opened Dec. 2, 2025 (Ski Utah 2025-26 list); season extended through May 10, 2026 after late snowfall (TownLift; Brighton press release https://www.brightonresort.com/press-kit/press-releases/brighton-resort-announces-25-26-season-extended). Search summaries.

season.notes: No official 2026-27 opening date on the saved pages (2026-10-03); Go Cards are "Valid Opening Day 2026 through Closing Day, April 2027". OnTheSnow gives an "estimated start date of 2026 Dec 04 and a tentative end date of 2027 May 09" (third-party estimate, not an announcement). 2025-26 ran Dec. 2, 2025 – May 10, 2026 (extended).

hours.label: Day lifts
hours.note: All lifts 9am–4pm when there is no night riding. On night-riding days Explorer, Majestic and Crest 6 run 9am–9pm, Snake Creek to 8:30pm, Milly to 8pm, Great Western to 4pm.

source.note: Brighton help center "How late is each lift open?" and Hours of Operation page (search summary). Page fetching was blocked (egress), so this is a web-search result summary, not a direct read of the page.

hours.label: Night riding
hours.note: Wednesday–Monday (no night riding Tuesday), conditions permitting, mid-December to late March. No night riding on Christmas Eve, Christmas Day or New Year's Eve.

source.note: Brighton night-riding page and help center (search summary). Page fetching was blocked (egress), so this is a web-search result summary, not a direct read of the page.

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (I-80 E and I-215 S to Exit 6 / 6200 South, Wasatch Blvd to the canyon mouth, then SR-190 up Big Cottonwood Canyon); not a routing-service result. Storm days, traction-law enforcement and avalanche-control closures of SR-190 can add hours.

source.note: Piste estimate

transfers.name: UTA ski bus (Big Cottonwood Canyon service)
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: Utah Transit Authority has run winter ski-bus service from Salt Lake Valley park-and-ride lots up SR-190 to Solitude and Brighton. 2026-27 routes, schedule and fares are unconfirmed.

transfers.name: Shared or private airport shuttles from SLC
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: several private operators run airport transfers to the Cottonwood Canyon and Park City resorts. No operator, fare or schedule is on file.

transfers.name: Rental car from SLC
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: Utah applies a winter traction law in the Cottonwood canyons (SR-190 Big Cottonwood) that can require 4WD/AWD or suitable snow tires/chains. Parking rules for 2026-27 are unknown.

conflicts: Vertical: published 1,875 ft vs. 1,745 ft implied by the 8,755 ft base and 10,500 ft top.
Night riding size: lift-tickets page says "32 lit runs and 5 lifts, six nights a week"; homepage stats say 30 night-riding trails.
Lifts/runs: OnTheSnow lift-ticket page says 67 slopes and 9 lifts; stored 66 trails / 8 lifts from earlier summaries.

Night riding days: Brighton's own pages (search summary, 2026-10-03) give Wednesday–Monday, 4–9pm. An earlier third-party summary (2026-09-30: Visit Utah, Visit Salt Lake, Ski Utah) said Monday to Saturday nights. Stored: Brighton's own schedule.

The same 2026-10-03 hours summary said "Brighton is closed Tuesdays for scheduled maintenance". It is unclear whether this means the whole day or night riding only, so the day-lift days are left unset.
